source_title: The New ‘ACOTAR’ Book Is Finally Here, and Amazon Is Discounting the Original Series to Celebrate
source_excerpt:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Rolling Stone may receive an affiliate commission.
It’s been 11 years since Sarah J. Maas released A Court of Thorns and Roses , the first book in her smash-hit fantasy series . Now, the highly anticipated sixth installment, A Court of Splintered Harmony: The Valkyrie Cycle, Movement I , has finally arrived on Amazon.
Hitting shelves on Oct. 27, the novel is already a bestseller, ranking No. 1 on Amazon’s book charts. It clocks in at 352 pages, and while it isn’t the final book in the series — another drop is expected in 2027 — fans have been eagerly waiting years for this launch.
Early reviews have been nothing short of glowing, with readers commenting that they “need more now” and praising how easily the book “keeps you engaged.”
A Court of Splintered Harmony: The Valkyrie Cycle, Movement I
🌹Book seven in the series will be released on Jan. 12, 2027.
It’s currently listed at $22.38 on Amazon, which is 30% off its original price. And for fans of the ACOTAR universe, that’s not the only deal worth shopping. The A Court of Thorns and Roses paperback box set has also had its price slashed by a whopping 40%. That brings the five-book set down from $95 to just $49.80 — just in time for some sultry seasonal reading. The box set has been discounted before, but there’s a good chance the price could go back up at any time, so fans may want to act fast.
A Court of Thorns and Roses Paperback Box Set
The box set includes the first five books in the A Court of Thorns and Roses series: A Court of Thorns and Roses , A Court of Mist and Fury , A Court of Wings and Ruin , A Court of Frost and Starlight , and A Court of Silver Flames . The series follows Feyre Archeron, a young huntress whose life is upended after she kills a magical wolf and is taken to the faerie lands of Prythian.
Even if you’ve already read the series, the box set is a great way for fans to revisit Prythian before diving into the sixth book. Maas has also released books in her Crescent City series in recent years, and fans can also get the three-book box set for that series here , which is also discounted on Amazon by 26%.
🌹Also available in paperback and Kindle formats.
